fullPassage: There are reasons why science is not fully trusted and why healthy skepticism and critical thinking are essential. In spite of professional standards, claims of objectivity, and the peer review process, the conduct of science can be biased. All experts are not the same, nor do they submit their work to the same scrutiny. Knowing the source of funding can be important in evaluating scientific claims. For example, the Harvard researchers who made claims in the late 1960s about the problems with dietary fat, leading the nation away from perceiving sugar as one of the main causes in health problems, were funded in part by the sugar industry. The authors did not reveal their funding source to the New England Journal of Medicine, where their influential article appeared. Their article shaped a generation of changes in eating patterns that appears to have discouraged higher use of sugar, now widely implicated as a source of the rise in obesity and diabetes. Stories such as this one fuel suspicion — but also lead to further safeguards in the scientific process. Funding disclosures, although not required five decades ago, have since been made compulsory.

det.tip: conduct: 수행(the conduct of ~), 행동/행실(good conduct), 지휘(conduct an orchestra)

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"careful and thorough examination or inspection"

det.korean: careful and thorough examination = scrutiny(정밀 조사)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ scrutiny(정밀 조사): 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ① suspicion(의심): 믿지 않는 느낌
❌ ② disclosure(공개): 정보를 드러내는 것
❌ ③ conduct(수행/행동): 검토와 다른 의미
det.tip: scrutiny = close examination = 면밀한 조사

questions.passage: In spite of professional standards, claims of objectivity, and the peer review process, the conduct of science can be __________ (bias). All experts are not the same, nor do they submit their work to the same scrutiny.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오. (영어로)

The conduct of science can be __________. (bias)

det.korean: 명사 bias → 형용사/과거분사 biased. be동사 뒤 보어로 과거분사 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ biased: bias(명사) → biased(형용사/p.p.). can be biased = 편향될 수 있다
det.tip: bias(편향, 명사) → biased(편향된, 형용사)

questions.passage: In spite of professional standards, claims of __________ (object), and the peer review process, the conduct of science can be biased. All experts are not the same, nor do they submit their work to the same scrutiny.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오. (영어로)

In spite of professional standards, claims of __________, and the peer review process, the conduct of science can be biased. (object)

det.korean: 명사 object → 명사 objectivity(객관성). 전치사 of 뒤 추상 명사 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ objectivity: object → objective(형용사) → objectivity(추상 명사)
det.tip: object(대상) → objective(객관적인) → objectivity(객관성)

questions.passage: There are reasons why science is not fully trusted and why healthy skepticism and critical thinking are essential. In spite of professional standards, claims of objectivity, and __________, the conduct of science can be biased. All experts are not the same, nor do they submit their work to the same scrutiny. Knowing the source of funding can be important in evaluating scientific claims. For example, the Harvard researchers who made claims in the late 1960s about the problems with dietary fat, leading the nation away from perceiving sugar as one of the main causes in health problems, were funded in part by the sugar industry. The authors did not reveal their funding source to the New England Journal of Medicine, where their influential article appeared. Their article shaped a generation of changes in eating patterns that appears to have discouraged higher use of sugar, now widely implicated as a source of the rise in obesity and diabetes. Stories such as this one fuel suspicion — but also lead to further safeguards in the scientific process. Funding disclosures, although not required five decades ago, have since been made compulsory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전문적 기준, 객관성 주장, 그리고 동료 심사 과정(the peer review process)에도 불구하고.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ the peer review process: 과학의 질 보장 장치, 같은 문맥 ←정답
❌ ① the sugar industry: 다른 위치의 내용
❌ ② a generation of changes: 다른 위치의 내용
❌ ④ the rise in obesity: 다른 위치의 내용
det.tip: peer review = 동료 심사. 과학의 질을 보장하는 제도적 장치
